name: bearings
description: Keeps a glossary of the conversation's terms and a map of where the work stands, in panes opened from a band above the prompt, with a btw input for side questions.

model.title: Background model
model.description: The model that updates the glossary and bearings after each turn: an alias (sonnet, haiku) or a model id.

curatorModel.title: Curator model
curatorModel.description: The model that corrects the facts' importance every 5 turns: an alias (sonnet, haiku) or a model id.

ranking.title: Fact ranking
ranking.description: Who orders the facts in view. mechanical: local scoring. llm: the update call re-ranks a shortlist. Any other value means mechanical.
